subject: Developer Office Hours — conditional promo seed allocation
messages:
From: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@codebridge.co>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: community@codebridge.co
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Request: promo codes for Nov 30 developer office hours

Hi Avery,

Thanks for taking a minute earlier. Quick ask: CodeBridge runs a monthly Developer Office Hours livestream (Nov 30). We typically offer a short trial/demo package for attendees — would Redwood be open to providing 150 trial credits (two-week trials) as promo codes we can distribute during the event? The promo drives a tracked signup and we'd like the codes to expire 30 days after issuance.

Quick context: last month we had ~420 attendees, but this session is focused on infra/ops and we expect ~220. We can gate codes to registrants and provide a post-event usage report (emails + HubSpot ids).

If feasible, we want to finalize by Monday so we can add codes to the event drip sequence. Happy to sign an MSA addendum if required.

Best,
Sara
Sara Nguyen
Community Lead | CodeBridge

Attachments: none
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@codebridge.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: promo codes for Nov 30 developer office hours

Hi Sara — thanks for the ask and the attendee estimate. We can support a limited promo seed but would like to tie the release to a simple usage threshold and a short post-event audit to avoid churn misuse. Proposed approach:

- We issue 150 single-use promo codes, each granting a 14-day trial (no automatic conversion).
- Codes expire 30 days after issuance.
- Condition: we will release only 75 codes up front. Remaining 75 are released after you provide the attendee list and a basic engagement metric (attendance > 40% of registrants OR 100+ unique joins).
- We require a short attestation email from CodeBridge post-event with the HubSpot export and an events summary.

I'll attach our standard promo-seed policy (short) and a template for the code delivery CSV — if you can confirm the gating and the reporting plan, I will route for a quick approvals sync with Growth.

Avery Johnson
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments: promo_seed_policy.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: promo codes for Nov 30 developer office hours

Avery — love the conditional split. A couple of operational notes before we commit:

- Confirm whether these are rate-limited per account (we prefer single-use codes tied to email).
- We should set a soft cap on per-account usage and flag any accounts that create >2 seats in the trial window.
- For reporting: HubSpot export + a simple CSV of redeemed codes (email + timestamp) will be enough for our records.

If Rishi can sign off on the risk side, I'm fine approving 150 with the 75/75 conditional release. Priyom — ops, can you prep the seed_codes_batch_A.csv template?

Marissa
Director, Growth Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: promo codes for Nov 30 developer office hours

All — ok from security/risk; single-use, email-tied codes with a 14-day trial cap and automatic detection for rapid seat creation. Flagging for ops: if CodeBridge provides the HubSpot export within 7 days post-event and we see legitimate attendance, ops can release tranche 2. Priyom — please prepare the CSV and set the expiration window as Avery noted.

Avery — Sara, if you confirm the gating (registrant-only distribution) and are comfortable with the post-event export, we'll issue 75 codes today and hold 75 pending the report. We'll attach the promo_seed_policy.pdf and a small template (seed_codes_batch_A.csv) for your team.

Thanks,
Rishi
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
